ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), particularly the registration, registered office, registered agent, register of directors and register of members provisions; Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended); AML/CFT Rules and Guidance issued by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) for licensed agents; Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) directives; UN Security Council sanctions implementing regulations; Samoa is a member of the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG)
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — International Companies maintain registers of members and beneficial ownership records exclusively at the licensed registered agent in Samoa; the register is not open to public inspection and Samoa maintains no public UBO register. Beneficial ownership information is disclosed only to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit, the Registrar, and foreign regulators through lawful demand, court order, or TIEA/DTA information-exchange channels. Nominee arrangements are lawful, but the natural-person beneficial owner must be disclosed to the registered agent and recorded internally.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — internal form; notarization required only when exhibited to third-party KYC or regulatory bodies

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport or national identity document of each director, shareholder and beneficial owner (at/above 25% threshold)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — Samoa is not a contracting party to the Hague Apostille Convention 1961; notarization must be followed by authentication of the notary's signature by the competent Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the origin country and legalization by a Samoan diplomatic/consular mission with jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months) for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — certified notarial copy plus authentication by the origin country's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Samoan consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry in the corporate UBO's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — notarized signature page plus destination-embassy legalization where required by the receiving bank or counterparty

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and authorized signatories at onboarding and on a continuous basis against: (i) Samoa domestic sanction/denial lists; (ii) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (iii) US OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists; and (iv) EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions, with specific enhanced attention to Russian-origin Grade A copper cathodes (banned in US/UK markets) and Iran/CDO-adjacent metal supply chains. PEP status (domestic and foreign) is assessed for all natural persons; any PEP or sanctions hit mandates registered-agent senior management approval, enhanced source-of-wealth documentation, and a mandatory suspicious transaction report to the Samoa FIU. For LME warrant transfer and documentary LC payment rails, the protocol extends screening to the LME brand warrant issuer, counterparty, issuing bank, confirming bank, and vessel chain to mitigate trade-based money laundering and sanctions evasion risk in the base-metals arbitrage corridor.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Registrar of Companies / Registrar of International Companies — Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL); all name clearance filings for International Companies are submitted electronically by a SIFA-licensed registered agent via the Companies Registry online interface (www.mcil.gov.ws / licensed agent portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the prescribed working language for International Company names; the registry operates in Latin-script characters only. Samoan or Chinese trading names are permissible solely in romanized/English transliteration, and the transliteration must not duplicate an existing registered name or contain reserved tokens. A formal English name in the pattern 'X Limited' is mandatory for the certificate of incorporation; any Chinese business alias is maintained privately in transaction documents and is not recorded in the Samoan registry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: International Company (absent the required licensing context)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The licensed registered agent files the name clearance application and the Registrar usually responds within 1–2 business days. Upon rejection, the agent may: (1) submit up to three revised name alternatives for a fresh search within the same application cycle at no additional statutory fee; (2) apply for a single 30-day extension of an approved reservation before its expiry; (3) request a written statement of reasons and administrative reconsideration from the Registrar within 14 days of the rejection; and (4) if reconsideration fails, petition the Supreme Court of Samoa for judicial review as the final remedy. Parallel reservation of the same name in the domestic company registry is not permitted for an International Company.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Accepted — every International Company must maintain a statutory registered office in Samoa, which in practice is the physical office of a SIFA-licensed registered agent. Remote/virtual administration is standard: board meetings, treasury decisions, and compliance functions may be conducted anywhere in the world, and no local employees, leased premises, or physical presence in Samoa are required, provided the registered agent and registered office obligations are continuously discharged.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<5% per annum) — SIFA supervises licensed agents and conducts on-site inspections of agent records rather than of individual International Companies; no established practice of unannounced physical inspection of the company's own Samoan premises exists. Inspection risk materializes only upon an FIU or Registrar investigation, a formal AML complaint, or a TIEA-driven foreign tax authority request. The more probable scrutiny channel for this copper-cathode trading entity is bank and LME-counterparty KYC/EDD review rather than Samoan regulatory inspection.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), Part II (Incorporation), Sections 5-8; International Companies Regulations 1998; Companies Act 2001 (residual applicability)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with Form 1 (Application for Registration of an International Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; no statutory escrow account or capital deposit mandate. Shares may be issued at par or premium in any major currency; the company may commence business immediately upon incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the company accepts and records the subscription for 1,000 ordinary shares of US$1.00 each at par by the subscriber named in the Memorandum and that such shares are allotted and issued fully paid. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the registered office of the company shall be situated at the address of the Registered Agent in Apia, Samoa, and that the Registered Agent be authorised to act as such and file the annual returns. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the directors named in the minutes are appointed as Directors and Secretary, each to hold office until the next annual general meeting, with authority to open bank accounts, sign commercial documents, and execute the common seal of the company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL via the Samoa online corporate registry portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through a licensed Samoan registered agent. Verify name availability against the integrated registry database. Ensure the proposed name ends with 'Limited' or 'International' or an approved abbreviation. The registered agent must confirm acceptance in writing and file the agent consent form.
required_dossiers: Written consent of the registered agent
Certified copy of the proposed company name approval letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as identical or prohibited, the applicant may file a revised name application with a new name, or request administrative review within 14 days of the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Offshore Service Provider and Notary Public / Commissioner for Oaths
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage the registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with International Companies Act 1987. The subscriber must execute the incorporation documents before a notary public or other recognised officer. The registered agent certifies the execution and arranges any share subscription statements.
required_dossiers: Subscriber identification documents (passport or national ID) and proof of residential address
Registered agent signed consent and undertaking
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar objects to a clause in the Articles, revise and file substituted Articles within the requisition period. Effective amendment takes place upon re-execution and re-certification by the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form 1 (Application for Registration) together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, registered agent consent, and any required declarations to the Registrar either physically at MCIL or through the approved electronic filing system. Ensure all statutory filing fees are paid via bank transfer or government cashier.
required_dossiers: Form 1 (Application for Registration of an International Company)
Certified copy of the registered agent consent
Subscriber due diligence pack (certified passport copies, bank reference, professional reference)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query or requisition, the applicant must respond with written clarifications within 14 days. Missed responses can be cured by resubmission of corrected forms and payment of an additional processing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIL Finance Section and Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the official state filing fee to the government designated bank account, present proof of payment to the Registrar, and receive the Certificate of Incorporation and certified copies. The company is legally incorporated on the date the certificate is executed by the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment (bank transfer confirmation or cashier receipt)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is withheld due to payment discrepancy, reconcile receipt at the MCIL Finance Section; if the certificate contains errors, file a rectification request under Section 65 of the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Governance and Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting to adopt the pro-forma resolution, confirm appointments of directors and secretary, adopt the registered office address, authorise the issuance of share certificates, and approve the opening of bank accounts with any international bank or licensed financial institution recognised in Samoa.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting or written shareholder resolution
Appointment forms for directors and secretary
Bank account opening resolution and directors' identification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the account application, issue a certified copy of board resolution and updated corporate public register search to satisfy know-your-customer requirements, and if needed, substitute or add a second director approved by the bank.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable; Samoa does not issue an industrial operational permit for offshore international companies engaged in wholesale trading of non-ferrous metals. If a physical warehouse or storage depot is established later, the competent authority would be the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — statutory business license exemption applies to International Companies under the International Companies Act 1987

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Division of Environment and Conservation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable at incorporation stage; the company does not conduct local emissions, wastewater discharge, or hazardous waste handling. Any future physical storage of metal in Samoa exceeding threshold quantities will require environmental permit assessment and compliance with MNRE waste regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for registered offshore office activity. If a local office or warehouse is established, the entity must obtain a fire safety certificate from Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) and comply with the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2002, including structural load inspection certification.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue, Government of Samoa (MOR) – Taxpayer Services; online portal: Samoa Tax Administration e-Services via Ministry of Revenue website (https://www.revenue.gov.ws)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities establishing as an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 1987 must first obtain a Certificate of Incorporation from the Registrar of International Companies. The IC then applies to the Ministry of Revenue for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) using Form TIN-01, submitting the Certificate of Incorporation, constitutional documents, registered agent confirmation, and beneficial owner identification documents. The MOR issues the TIN within 5–10 business days. An IC holding a valid International Company tax exemption certificate is generally exempt from income tax but must maintain a TIN for customs, VAGST, and statistical reporting purposes if any import/export transactions occur.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election is available under Samoa domestic law. International Companies are statutorily tax-exempt under the International Companies Act 1987. The IC may elect to be treated as a non-resident company for exchange control purposes, but no tax status election exists. Tax characterization is fixed by statute and does not permit pass-through or entity-classification elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 60,000 (Samoan Tala) in taxable supplies per 12-month period; non-resident International Companies without a fixed establishment in Samoa are not required to register unless they make taxable supplies in Samoa, in which case the WST 60,000 threshold applies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not currently mandate real-time electronic invoicing, fiscal clearance, or digital stamping. Tax invoices must be issued in accordance with VAGST Act 2008 and retained in electronic or paper form for audit purposes. No API-based clearance or government digital invoicing stamping regime is in effect.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible movable goods (including non-ferrous copper cathodes) are zero-rated under the VAGST Act 2008. To claim the 0% rate, the IC must be a registered VAGST person, the sale must be to a person outside Samoa, the goods must be physically exported from Samoa within the statutorily prescribed period, and the IC must hold contemporaneous documentation proving export. Offshore services supplied to non-resident customers may also qualify if performed outside Samoa. The IC must not be engaging in domestic consumption of the goods.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Samoa Customs Service approved form)
Bill of Lading (or equivalent transport document such as Air Waybill or CMR) issued to the non-resident consignee
Inward Remittance Certificate from a licensed Samoan commercial bank evidencing receipt of export proceeds in foreign currency
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry of Revenue and Samoa Customs Service conduct risk-based audits of export zero-rating claims. Fraudulent or unsupported zero-rating declarations are subject to retrospective assessment for unpaid VAT at 15%, interest accruing from the date of supply, and civil penalties of up to 150% of the tax amount. Criminal prosecution may arise under the Tax Administration Act 2002 and Customs Act 2014, carrying fines and imprisonment terms. Input tax credits are clawed back where export documentation is missing or where goods were diverted to domestic use. The limitation period for recovery is generally 3 years for reasonable care situations, extendable to 7 years for fraud or willful default.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) operating under the Exchange Control Act 1976, Exchange Control Regulations 1977, and Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended), with exclusive regulatory authority over authorized dealers and the cross-border capital account for Samoa.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is fully convertible for current-account transactions under a managed float, but capital-account inflows and outflows by resident entities require CBS approval, licensing, or registration. The WS_IC, as a non-resident International Company incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987, benefits from the statutory exchange-control exemption (section 128), rendering the Exchange Control Act inapplicable to its offshore copper cathode trading and capital movements. Profit remittance for non-resident ICs is similarly unblocked for non-Samoan-source earnings; however, any Samoan-source income (e.g., storage or logistics invoiced by a Samoan branch) would require CBS remittance approval, tax clearance from the Ministry of Revenue, and applicable withholding tax certification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Samoan resident exporters must repatriate export proceeds within 30 days of shipment and surrender them to an authorized dealer for conversion into WST unless a CBS-approved foreign-currency account exemption is held. The WS_IC is outside this surrender regime because it is a non-resident IC conducting offshore commodity arbitrage; nonetheless, all export proceeds routed through a Samoan banking relationship must be supported by full trade documentation (sale contract, invoice, bill of lading, weight and assay certificates) to demonstrate that the flows are genuine international commerce and not disguised domestic earnings.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account, USD Trade Settlement Account, and Documentary Letter of Credit Facility
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Operational Account and WST Domestic Settlement Account
Operational Account and Enhanced Due Diligence Corporate Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Samoa maintains no statutory fintech EMI or digital banking licensing framework; non-bank payment service providers require a money remittance licence under the Money Remittance Act 2011 and CBS approval. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Revolut, Airwallex) cannot access Samoan domestic clearing or hold WST-denominated accounts without a licensed local intermediary, and any EMI receiving Samoa-sourced funds without a CBS licence would contravene Samoan law. The WS_IC treasury should therefore use licensed Samoan commercial banks for all LME settlement, documentary LC, and USD clearing, restricting EMIs to incidental offshore operating expenses only.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Samoan banks generally mandate an in-person onboarding interview in Apia for at least one director or a duly authorized corporate officer of a non-resident IC. Remote opening is permissible in limited cases where the licensed registered agent (international company service provider) co-signs the account mandate, corporate documents are notarized and apostilled, and the bank completes enhanced due diligence with live video verification; however, a fully remote opening without any local nexus is not available for 'Medium_Risk_Enhanced' copper cathode traders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company without economic substance and with nominee shareholders, triggering beneficial ownership and jurisdiction-risk flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the WS_IC Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, current register of directors and ultimate beneficial owners, registered agent confirmation letter, audited or management accounts, group organizational chart, and a substance declaration evidencing physical copper trading operations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Direct shareholder subscriptions and intercompany loan proceeds must be routed via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 from the parent or principal trading house to the WS_IC's USD account at the appointed Samoan authorized dealer. The remitting instruction must cite the correct balance-of-payments purpose code (direct investment equity injection or intercompany trade financing), and the receiving bank will require a certified board resolution authorizing the account, the capital structure, and confirmation that no CBS approval applies by virtue of the IC exchange-control exemption. All inbound funds should be consolidated in the USD Trade Settlement Account and hedged forward before conversion into WST for local disbursements.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail is the SWIFT MT103 single-customer credit transfer settlement against physical delivery, complemented by an irrevocable documentary letter of credit (UCP600) with sight or deferred payment terms where bank risk mitigation is required. Trade settlements for LME Grade A copper cathodes must synchronize the electronic LME warrant transfer via LMEsmart with the SWIFT payment instruction, using the nominated Samoan bank's USD correspondent clearing network (typically New York or Sydney) and presenting commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, independent surveyor report, and certificate of analysis to the LC bank. MT202 COV is used for bank-to-bank onward transfer to LME clearing agents for warrant registration and margin settlement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable USD/WST forward contracts with licensed Samoan authorized dealers for conversion of operational WST balances
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in USD/CNY and USD/EUR for copper cathode trade settlement exposure, permissible for non-resident ICs where WST deliverability is restricted
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR and USD/CNY) executed through CBS-licensed international banking units or foreign global banks for long-dated trade receivables and payables
LME copper futures and metal swaps to hedge cathode price volatility, executed through regulated LME members or FCM brokers outside Samoa
FX options for USD/AUD hedging where the counterparty is a CBS-registered authorized dealer with derivatives authorization

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 30 June; new companies may renew on incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of WST 100 per month or part thereof; continued non-payment after 3 months may trigger administrative strike-off and restoration costs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return / Confirmation Statement of International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default fine of WST 50 per day; persistent default for 6 months may result in deregistration and asset vesting in the Crown

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Agent and Registered Office Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed International Company Service Provider / Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At each annual review cycle concurrent with the Annual Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a current licensed agent and local registered office violates the International Companies Act; may lead to de-strategic ruling, penalty orders, and strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for an International Company unless the shareholders require it by unanimous resolution or the company is carrying on banking, insurance, or other regulated licensed activity
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS, or internationally accepted accounting standards such as US GAAP, if financial statements are voluntarily prepared; no local GAAP filing requirement for exempt International Companies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO filing; the registered agent must maintain a current Register of Ultimate Beneficial Owners and request updated beneficial ownership declarations after any share transfer; UBO data must be updated within 14 days of a transfer or change in control

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - 6,000 (only if voluntarily audited; no statutory audit requirement)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies are exempt from Samoan income tax on all foreign-sourced income and on qualifying offshore business activities. No capital gains tax applies. A flat annual license fee applies in lieu of income tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Declaration (Form IC-AD) filed through the Samoa Ministry for Revenue (MFR) electronic filing portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 90 days after the end of the International Company's fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company registration number and licensed name of the International Company
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name and registration number as recorded in the International Companies Register; no local tax identification number required for offshore-only entities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name, address, and agent license number in Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the licensed registered agent appointed under the International Companies Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year-end date and declaration period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entities commonly elect a calendar-year or offshore-aligned fiscal year; the declared period must not exceed 12 months unless a transitional period is approved.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of compliance with the Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) and declaration of core income-generating activities in Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For pure offshore wholesale trading of copper cathodes with no Samoa-based management or physical activity, declare 'Not subject to Samoa economic substance requirements' where the entity is tax resident in a foreign jurisdiction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual license fee calculation and payment confirmation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The flat annual government fee based on declared share capital or agent-confirmed tier is due with the declaration; no income tax calculation is required for non-resident-owned offshore operations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification by director and registered agent attesting accuracy of the declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: At least one director (may be a non-resident natural person) and the licensed registered agent must sign the declaration under penalty of perjury.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual declaration attracts a monetary penalty of WST 1,000. Continued non-filing may result in automatic strike-off of the company from the International Companies Register and the imposition of additional late penalties plus director disqualification orders. The registered agent may also incur fines for failure to maintain company records.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No conventional income tax treaty network applies to International Companies resident in Samoa; dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders are exempt from Samoan withholding tax at source. No tax ruling or TRC submission is required for outbound distributions from an exempt offshore International Company.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate for royalties and interest paid by an International Company to non-residents where the income is sourced outside Samoa. No treaty rates apply in the absence of a relevant double tax agreement.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable on a statutory basis; Samoa does not impose mandatory Local File or Master File documentation for International Companies operating under the zero-tax offshore regime. Transfer pricing documentation may nonetheless be required by the offshore customer or intermediary jurisdiction (e.g., parent-company country), and prudent practice mandates contemporaneous intercompany documentation.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa's Economic Substance Regulations apply to International Companies conducting geographically mobile activities. Wholesale trading in copper cathodes is not a specified 'relevant activity' under the core ESR categories (banking, insurance, shipping, IP holding, headquarters, distribution and service centers), but if the company claims foreign tax residence, the foreign tax authority's economic substance rules will be applied by that jurisdiction. Where actual management and control are found to be exercised in Samoa, the entity may be deemed resident and subject to ESR compliance including adequate physical presence, local directors, and income-generating activity testing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Claiming foreign tax residence without any substantive management, employees, or office in the foreign jurisdiction while continuing actual management and control by directors resident in Samoa or by a Samoan registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reclassification of the International Company as a Samoa-tax-resident entity, imposition of income tax at the applicable Samoan corporate rate on deemed Samoa-source income, and penalties up to 100% of the tax undercharged. The International Companies Registrar may also strike off the company and the registered agent may be fined.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations of foreign residence or falsify the annual declaration are personally liable for civil restitution, disqualification from serving as directors for up to five years, and potential imprisonment for up to seven years under the criminal provisions of the International Companies Act and the Tax Administration Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operation as a pure shell company with a registered agent in Samoa, no physical office, no bank account, no accounting records, and no genuine principal-to-principal trading activity in copper cathodes, used solely to issue invoices and route LME warrant transfers without commercial substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compulsory striking-off from the International Companies Register, forfeiture of the annual license, and prohibition on carrying on business in Samoa. If the company engages in transactions with Samoan residents or derives Samoan-source income, back taxes and late payment penalties are assessable.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the beneficial owner may be jointly and severally liable for all corporate debts and unpaid fees where the court pierces the corporate veil. Directors may be subject to travel bans pending investigation and personally ordered to restore misappropriated funds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company to finance trade through documentary letters of credit and LME warrant transfers where the underlying counterparty, vessel, or payment beneficiary is subject to EU, US, or UN sanctions; falsifying bills of lading; over-invoicing or under-invoicing physical copper cathode deliveries to move value across borders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Freezing of bank accounts by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit; seizure of proceeds; civil forfeiture proceedings; fines up to WST 2 million per violation; referral to the Samoa Attorney General for criminal prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners may be criminally prosecuted for money laundering and terrorism financing. Sanctions may extend to personal travel bans, asset freezes, extradition to sanction-imposing states, and custodial sentences of up to 14 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fatal Tax Filings / Fraudulent Annual Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting a knowingly false annual declaration, concealing the true ultimate beneficial owner, failing to maintain accounting records of cross-border copper cathode trades, or mis-describing the commercial activity as 'tax-exempt non-resident' when in fact management and decision-making occur in Samoa.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Void filing, imposition of a surcharge of 50% of any tax that would have been payable, late payment interest of 12% per annum, and criminal fines of WST 25,000 per false declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability upon the signing directors and registered agent; imprisonment up to 10 years for tax evasion by false statement; personal liability for outstanding corporate penalties and restoration of wrongfully obtained tax advantages.
